name: MakerWorld
author: David Reed
description: MakerWorld (Bambu Lab) activity in your Omarchy bar and as desktop notifications. A bar pill shows your point balance and an unread badge, and highlights in your theme accent when something has arrived since you last opened the popup. The popup has an Activity tab (recent comments, replies, likes, system messages - open any on makerworld.com, mark all read) and a My models tab (your published designs with per-model downloads, likes, prints and comments). A headless service polls your Bambu Cloud account and notifies for new comments, replies, likes, followers, points, boost tokens, boost-token expiry, and download / like milestones. Unofficial - it uses the same endpoints the Bambu Handy app does, so you sign in once with the bundled makerworld-login helper.

barWidget.description: Point balance and an unread badge for your MakerWorld account that lights up when there's something new, a popup with recent activity and a 'my models' stats tab, and desktop notifications.

schema.label: Desktop notifications for new activity: on or off
Notify for which categories (comma list): comment,reply,like,follow,system,points - or 'all'
Auto-dismiss notification after N seconds (0 = notification-daemon default)
Sound file to play on each notification (blank = silent)
Max notifications per check (1-20), so a backlog can't flood you
Clicking a notification opens the page: on or off
Show the point balance in the bar pill: on or off
Warn this many days before a boost token expires (0 = off, needs 'points' notifications on)
Notify when your models pass a round download / like total: on or off
Log raw API responses to the shell log: on or off
